about_item: 10-IN-1 COMPLETE TICK REMOVAL KIT - This all-inclusive set serves as the best tick remover for dogs, cats, and family safety. It strictly includes: 3x Stainless Steel Tools (Tick Remover + Tweezers + Clips), 2x Spoon-Shaped Tick Removal Tools, 2x Flea Combs, 1x Magnifying Glass, 10x Cleaning Pads, 1x Tick Identification Card, and 1x Breathable Mesh Storage Bag. This tick kit outperforms single tools, providing the right instrument for every tick removal scenario.

INNOVATIVE SPOON-SHAPED TICK REMOVER TOOLS - Our newly designed scoop-levers function as an effective tick puller and tick pick. Unlike a flat tick key, the curved spoon shape allows you to catch the pest during the twist action. This tick tool enables you to slide under the object and lift it intact, making it a superior tick remover for engorged pests.

PRECISION TICK TWEEZERS FOR HUMANS & PETS - Crafted from rust-resistant stainless steel, these tweezers for tick removal feature ultra-fine tips to grasp tiny nymphs. Whether used as a tick remover for humans or a tick remover for dogs, the high-tension grip allows for steady manual extraction without slipping, ensuring the head is removed alongside the body.

SAFE MECHANICAL TICK REMOVER PROTOCOL - Designed solely for physical extraction, this tick remover tool works by mechanical leverage. The V-slot tick puller for dogs allows you to lift the pest without squeezing its abdomen. This manual tick removal tool for dogs and cats avoids the risks associated with chemical sprays, offering a gentle solution for sensitive skin.

PORTABLE DOG TICK REMOVER TOOLS FOR OUTDOORS - Lightweight and compact, this tick removal tool for humans and pets is essential for hiking or camping. It fits easily in backpacks alongside other tick stick gear. The included magnifier and comb help you spot pests early, making this the ultimate tick removal tool set for active owners and their four-legged companions.

It comes with a carrying case that fits everything in it and is very compact and does not take up much space in a bag. The kit makes tick removal easy and quick. I would really recommend these.
